tabs.empty.title: No tabs yet
tabs.empty.text: Open a site to get started. Switching tabs does not reload the page — logins and conversations stay put.
pane.closed.title: Page closed
pane.closed.text: This page is closed and the memory it used has been released. Reopen it whenever you need — your login and conversations are still here.
pane.empty: Pick a site from the menu on the left
pane.blocked.title: This site could not load
pane.blocked.text: {{site}} could not load: the host has not allowed this domain. Built-in sites must be declared in webview.origins in the plugin manifest; custom pages are registered automatically when saved.
settings.title: Settings
settings.modeHint: Single focuses on one site; Split puts two side by side; Tabs brings many sites into one window.
settings.sitesHint: Checked sites appear in the site menu. Use the arrows to reorder.
settings.sitesNote: Built-in sites ship with the plugin; you can also add any https web page, each with its own login session.
settings.customDeleteConfirm: Delete the custom page “{{name}}”? Its login session will be removed too.
settings.customLimit: You can add up to {{count}} custom pages; the limit has been reached.
settings.customHint: Only https pages are supported. Pages see a desktop Chrome environment, and each site keeps its own login session.
settings.customError.max: The custom page limit has been reached
